alkylation_concentration.evidence: The cysteine residues were alkylated using 100 µl of 50 mM Iodoacetamide (IAM) in UA buffer.

cleavage_agent.evidence: The top filter units were transferred to a new collection tube and 100 µl DB containing 1 mAU of LysC was added and sample was incubated at 37 °C for 2 h.
Trypsin (1 µg) was added and sample was incubated overnight at 37 °C.
Trypsin digestion was initiated by addition of trypsin in 50 mM ABC buffer containing 10% (v/v) MeCN.
